title: MOFCGCNN Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A Jupyter notebook that synthesizes tabular training data for a Metal-Organic Framework Graph Neural Network (MOFCGNN) project, generating augmented data to support model training. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata and evaluates the output using SDV's run_diagnostic and evaluate_quality functions.
evidence: notebook.ipynb:350 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)' then synthesizer.fit(train); evaluate_quality called at line 430
